premise: A jointly learned world model can be reached through bounded shared episodes, bidirectional play/coplay feedback, and together-observed environmental updates, without reconstructing every participant's full origin path or metatheory.

world.name: SharedEpisodeWorld
world.purpose: Give huemans, machines, embodied small agents, simulations, and other systems a minimal common substrate for learning from shared episodes.
not_a_goal: Do not require full ancestry reconstruction for every participant.
Do not require importing every theory, metatheory, or agent architecture.
Do not clone Concordia, AI-town, or social simulation stacks; interoperate by episode records.
world.core_claim: The smallest useful common world model is an order-independent ledger of shared episodes whose colors, trits, time coordinates, fingerprints, and update outcomes are reproducible.

hueman_ideography.definition: A hueman is a color-bearing, embodied, socially legible participant role rather than a species-exclusive bucket.
hueman_ideography.standard: When a name can return durable state, prefer world_ builders with length, merge, and fingerprint over throwaway display identity.
ideographic_bias: Keep the substrate visible in the name.
Keep the operation composable in the name.
Use shared pronouns and shared episode records at boundaries.

Participant.description: Any system that can observe, act, or be affected in a shared episode.

Now.description: A bounded episode coordinate that aligns participants without requiring shared wall-clock metaphysics.

SharedEpisode.description: A together-observed interaction window with play, coplay, evidence, and update pressure.

Observation.description: A participant-local reading of the shared episode.

Play.description: Forward generative action into the environment.

Coplay.description: Backward feedback, validation, correction, or environment-returned consequence.

Witness.description: Neutral observed closure of play and coplay into a shareable update.

WorldUpdate.description: The smallest committed change to a participant or shared world state after an episode.

FitnessGate.description: A bounded resource rule: unfit candidate updates terminate before exhausting the open dynamical system.

helek.status: external vocabulary requested by the user; reserve as a coarse rendezvous window until a local code definition is added
helek.recommended_mapping: A helek should be represented as an integer number of glimpses and never as a float.

episode_now.recommended_default: A window of enough glimpses to include all participating modalities that must agree.

learning_loop.name: observe_together
learning_loop.description: Participants publish observations into the same episode window, preserving local offsets and modality rates.

learning_loop.name: play
learning_loop.description: A participant acts, proposes, gestures, speaks, simulates, or perturbs the environment.

learning_loop.name: coplay
learning_loop.description: Other participants and the environment return constraint, surprise, correction, reward, or refusal.

learning_loop.name: witness
learning_loop.description: The episode closes only when a shareable trace, justification, or residual is recorded.

learning_loop.name: update_or_die
learning_loop.description: Accepted updates alter world state; incoherent or over-budget candidates die before resource exhaustion.

learning_loop.name: fingerprint
learning_loop.description: The episode's canonical bytes, trits, and colors yield an order-independent verification handle.

gay_jl_responsibilities.color: Map episode ids, participants, and updates to deterministic colors with color_at and hash_color.
gay_jl_responsibilities.time: Represent shared nows with TritTick/glimpse-compatible integer coordinates.
gay_jl_responsibilities.trit: Classify play/coplay/witness pressure as GF(3) roles: +1, -1, 0.
gay_jl_responsibilities.entropy: Admit physical reality through ColoredTick sources rather than pure text-only assertions.
gay_jl_responsibilities.fingerprint: Provide SPI-compliant identity and order-independent merge checks.
gay_jl_responsibilities.world_builder: Expose any runtime implementation as a persistent world_ builder, not a print-and-discard routine.

syrup_responsibilities.serialization: Encode SharedEpisode records into canonical bytes for transport and hashing.
syrup_responsibilities.capability_transport: Carry episode references across OCapN/CapTP-style boundaries without collapsing trust boundaries.
syrup_responsibilities.zig_alignment: Keep time/color primitives available to low-level devices, sensors, and replay tools.

invariants: Same canonical episode bytes imply same episode_id, fingerprint, color, and trit checksum.
Merging episode sets is commutative and associative when fingerprints are XOR-style reductions over canonical episode fingerprints.
No participant's private origin story is required for episode-level convergence.
A world update must cite at least one shared observation or environmental feedback edge.
Resource budgets are first-class: losing hypotheses, bad fits, and incoherent candidates terminate early.
Play plus coplay plus witness conserves GF(3): generator, validator, and coordinator pressure must not drift unchecked.
Time is represented as integer glimpses/trit-ticks/flicks, never floating wall-clock time, at the verification boundary.

next_open_dynamical_system.description: The successor system is opened by replaying accepted episode updates, not by re-deriving every prior ontology.
next_open_dynamical_system.entry_condition: Enough shared episodes have accumulated that participants can predict, correct, and co-attend to each other's updates within bounded resource budgets.
next_open_dynamical_system.exit_condition: A successor world exposes a smaller, more coherent episode interface than the world it replaced.
